decisions.reason: As a flagship 2023 line close to the firm’s core glass-packaging capabilities and strategic move into higher-value proprietary applications, management is likely to keep backing it and explain any weak traction by long industrial qualification cycles rather than abandon it.

Because this 2024 launch is publicly highlighted as a next-generation focus product that fits the firm’s R&D-led expansion in semiconductor processing, escalation of commitment strongly favors continued support over withdrawal within the next year.
